observations.body: Solomon kneels before the assembly and prays across sin, defeat, drought, exile, foreigners, war, and return before asking God to remember mercies to David.
observations.label: Solomon’s Temple prayer repeatedly returns to David: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Solomon, Israel, foreigners, David, priests, and God, the Temple platform, heaven, land, war, and exile, kneeling, spreading hands, asking to hear, forgive, teach, restore, uphold the throne, and remember mercies visible within David's story or later memory.

observations.body: Solomon, Israel, foreigners, David, priests, and God · the Temple platform, heaven, land, war, and exile · kneeling, spreading hands, asking to hear, forgive, teach, restore, uphold the throne, and remember mercies · Davidic promise is carried into a prayer broad enough to imagine exile and return

payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 6:12–42 as its own royal, poetic, and prophetic memory David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places Davidic promise is carried into a prayer broad enough to imagine exile and return inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
